question: Simplify: x(3x - 6) + 4(x² -5) + 15
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine like terms: (3x² + 4x²) + (−6x) + (−20 + 15)

⇒ 7x² − 6x − 5

**∴ The correct answer is 7x² − 6x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given Expression:** x(3x − 6) + 4(x² − 5) + 15

**Method:** Apply the **Distributive Law** a(b + c) = ab + ac to expand the brackets and simplify by combining **like terms**.

⇒ x × 3x − x × 6 + 4 × x² − 4 × 5 + 15

⇒ 3x² − 6x + 4x² − 20 + 15

⇒ (3x² + 4x²) − 6x + (−20 + 15)

⇒ 7x² − 6x − 5

**∴ The correct answer is 7x² − 6x − 5.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Distributive Property

The property states that a(b + c) = ab + ac, which is used to remove parentheses in **algebraic expressions**.

Like Terms

Terms having the same **variable** and the same **exponent** (e.g., 3x² and 4x²) can be added or subtracted together.

BODMAS Rule

Always follow the order: **Brackets**, Orders (powers), **Division**, **Multiplication**, **Addition**, and **Subtraction**.</p
